question: How many hours can I work per fortnight during my course?
answer: You are allowed to work up to 48 hours per fortnight during your course.
sources: Student visa (subclass 500).txt; Hiring Student Visa Holders_ Condition 8104 & 8105 Guide.pdf

question: Can I work unlimited hours during scheduled course breaks?
answer: Yes, you can work unlimited hours during scheduled course breaks, as long as your course was deferred or suspended in line with Standard 9 of the National Code of Practice for Providers of Education and Training.
sources: Student visa (subclass 500).txt; Hiring Student Visa Holders_ Condition 8104 & 8105 Guide.pdf

question: Is there a work hour limit for Masters by Research or Doctoral students?
answer: There is no work hour limit for Masters by Research or Doctoral students, as they can work unlimited hours at any time after their enrolled course has officially commenced.
sources: Hiring Student Visa Holders_ Condition 8104 & 8105 Guide.pdf; Student visa (subclass 500).txt

question: What happens if I exceed my work hour limit?
answer: If you exceed your work hour limit, you may have your student visa cancelled.
sources: Student visa (subclass 500).txt; Hiring Student Visa Holders_ Condition 8104 & 8105 Guide.pdf

question: Do I need OSHC for my whole stay in Australia?
answer: No, you do not need OSHC for your whole stay in Australia. You need to have adequate health insurance arrangements in place for the duration of your stay in Australia, but the specific requirements and duration of coverage may vary depending on your individual circumstances and visa type.

question: How can I check my own visa conditions?
answer: You can check your own visa conditions by using VEVO, Visa Entitlement Verification Online.
sources: VEVO checking your own visa conditions.txt

question: How many days do I have to notify my provider of my address after arriving?
answer: You have 7 days to notify your education or training provider of your residential address after arriving in Australia.

question: What is the age limit to apply for the Temporary Graduate visa?
answer: You must be 35 years of age or under when you apply for the Temporary Graduate visa.
sources: Temporary Graduate visa (subclass 485) Post-Higher Education Work stream6.pdf; Temporary Graduate visa (subclass 485) Second Post-Higher Education Work stream11.pdf; Temporary Graduate visa (subclass 485) Post-Vocational Education Work stream1.pdf

question: What streams are available under the subclass 485 visa?
answer: The streams available under the subclass 485 visa are the Graduate Work stream and the Skilled-Recognised Graduate (subclass 476) visa.
sources: Changes to the Temporary Graduate (Subclass 485) visa _ Study Australia.pdf; Temporary Graduate visa (subclass 485) Second Post-Higher Education Work stream11.pdf; Temporary Graduate visa (subclass 485) Second Post-Higher Education Work stream13.pdf

question: Do I need to have held a student visa recently to apply?
answer: You do not need to have held a student visa recently to apply for a Temporary Graduate visa (subclass 485) Post-Higher Education Work stream.
sources: Temporary Graduate visa (subclass 485) Post-Higher Education Work stream7.pdf; Temporary Graduate visa (subclass 485) Post-Higher Education Work stream6.pdf; Temporary Graduate visa (subclass 485) Second Post-Higher Education Work stream12.pdf

question: Does my qualification need to be from a CRICOS-registered course?
answer: Yes, your qualification needs to be from a CRICOS-registered course. The course requirements must be registered on the Commonwealth Register of Institutions and Courses for Overseas Students (CRICOS).
sources: 485 study requirement detail page.txt; Temporary Graduate visa (subclass 485).txt; Temporary Graduate visa (subclass 485) Second Post-Higher Education Work stream9.pdf

question: Can I change streams after I apply?
answer: You cannot change streams after you apply. The qualification you use to meet the Temporary Graduate visa study requirement determines the stream you can apply for, and this cannot be changed after the application has been submitted.
sources: Temporary Graduate visa (subclass 485).txt; Temporary Graduate visa (subclass 485) Post-Higher Education Work stream7.pdf
